title: 🏛️ RBI State Finances Study 2025–26 — Demographic Divergence & Southern States 30% Pension Burden
summary: RBI study categorized states into Youthful (<10% 60+), Intermediate (10-15%), and Ageing (15%+). Northern states (Bihar/UP) recorded 19.5% GSDP revenues; Southern states (Kerala/TN) saw pensions consume 30% of social spending amid 30% OADR. State fiscal deficit widened to 3.3% of GDP.
